summary: Select, specify, and review functional and effective brain-connectivity analyses, including seed correlation, partial correlation, ICA, PPI and gPPI, DCM and Bayesian model selection, Granger-causality limitations for fMRI, and graph-theoretic connectome analysis.
use_when: choose a functional or effective connectivity method
run PPI or generalized PPI analysis
specify or compare dynamic causal models
assess whether Granger causality is appropriate for fMRI
construct and analyze a brain connectivity graph
avoid_when: Temporal resolution or preprocessing cannot support the requested connectivity interpretation
Directed or causal claims are requested from an unsuitable observational method
Region definitions or connectivity matrices are not aligned across subjects
